rule.why: the r1 rule unchanged: a channel is broken only when max(p0,p1) exceeds 0.707 after the 99 % margin; biased-but-usable channels are charged in the per-channel accounting

per_job.K1: module ACCEPTS the block under policy exclude (health tests 0 failures, h_mcv >= 6.0, |lag1| <= 5/sqrt(N), no replay)
per_job.K4: buyer checker (qrng_fuggetlen, --expect-rows 1) PASS, accounting and exclusion recomputed

K5.basis: r0 under the rule excludes 1, r1 0

K6.basis: r0 h_acc 7.231, r1 7.300; floor = min - 0.5 bit

K7.basis: two jobs minutes apart under ONE vendor calibration; expected r 0.872 if the per-qubit bias is constant within a calibration (var_bias pooled over r0 and r1 / (var_bias + var_noise)); 0.25 margin as in r1; below the floor = the bias is not even stable over minutes = uncalibratable drift above shot noise
K7.scored_only_if: kalibracio last_update before job A == after job B; otherwise K7 and K8 are UNMEASURED (reported, not re-scored)

K8.basis: the bias correlation falls with calibration age (minutes, ~2 days, ~5 days); day-scale reference r(r0,r1) = 0.356

K9.basis: the vendor's readout-error table was stable r0<->r1 (r 0.954); r2 (snapshot before A) vs r1
